##: rCommander in the Scoop bucket degoya/scoop-rcommander (RC-100-52). Rendered from packaging/scoop/rcommander.json.in in degoya/rCommander by scripts/package-managers.sh and replaced by the release workflow with every release: change the template, not this file. No persist: the database lives in the user's data folder, not beside the program.
description: Two-panel file manager with terminals, SSH and SFTP
notes: rCommander installed through Scoop does not replace itself: update it with `scoop update rcommander`.
